exposure: Amniotic fluid index (AFI) categorized into <5 cm, >=5-8 cm, and >8 cm
cohort: 90 antenatal females presenting with term pregnancy were divided into three groups based on their amniotic fluid index.
finding: An amniotic fluid index (AFI) less than 5 cm is significantly associated with unfavorable fetal and maternal outcomes, including low birth weight, meconium-stained fluid, low APGAR score, and increased NICU admission.
mod_finding: An AFI less than 5 cm was linked to greater rates of surgical deliveries (LSCS).
cross-section timing: During term pregnancy and immediate perinatal period
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW) was an outcome measured.
